name: onboarding-system
description: Root-level dev orchestration only. The real backend (Python/FastAPI) and frontend (Vite/React) projects live in backend/ and frontend/ with their own dependencies -- this file does not replace either.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WORKER,WEB -c blue,green,magenta "cd backend && .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload" "cd backend && .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m app.bulk_queue" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
